# That Russian Girl Beauty Boutique

> Russian manicure studio based in Round Rock, Texas. A retro-glam studio on S Mays St in Round Rock: signature e-file cuticle work, Bio Sculpture Gel and a no-gap color finish, so your manicure looks clean up close and keeps going without chipping or lifting.

## Services
- Bio Gel manicure: The service the studio is most known and loved for: signature cuticle work, then Bio Sculpture Gel with a base matched to your nails and the no-gap color finish.
- Signature cuticle work: Meticulous cuticle care with the e-file and medically sterilized scissors, finished with the Vitamin Dose treatment and a blend of 10 oils.
- Bio Gel extensions: Extensions sculpted on a paper form under your natural nail, with no nail-plate filing or dehydration before the gel goes on.
- E-file dry pedicure: Often called the Russian pedicure: detailed toenail cuticle care, layer-by-layer dry callus removal with a disposable e-file disc, then a foot perfecting treatment.
- Nail art & chrome: Baby boomer ombre, chrome and pearl powders, French, stamping and hand-painted designs, added to any Bio Gel manicure.
- Private house call: The signature Bio Gel manicure with Ekaterina in the comfort of your home, within the studio's standard service area.

## About
That Russian Girl Beauty Boutique is a small studio in a suite on S Mays St in Round Rock, led by Ekaterina "Katya" Danilina, a Russian manicure specialist and educator. Her standard is simple: flawless cuticle work, strong but natural nails, a healthy natural nail first, and color laid so precisely there is no visible gap. Every manicure starts with the studio's signature cuticle work and finishes in Bio Sculpture Gel, a 10-free, hypoallergenic system. One of nine base coats is picked to match your nail's condition and hardness, which is why clients say their sets finally last past the one-week mark without chipping or lifting. Katya works alongside Julia Bilobrova, and clients also name Emma S. and Emma Y. in their reviews. And then there is the room. The lounge is part plant shop, part disco: hanging pothos and mirror balls, a cognac leather sofa, a red retro fridge, a coffee bar, a glowing TRG neon sign and a soft lavender light across the ceiling.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What is a Russian manicure?
  A: A very detailed manicure built around precise cuticle work, done dry with an e-file and sterilized scissors instead of soaking. Because the cuticle area is so clean, gel can be applied right up to it with no visible gap, and it grows out neatly.
- Q: What gel do you use?
  A: Only Bio Sculpture Gel, a 10-free, hypoallergenic system. One of nine base coats is chosen to match your nail condition, structure and hardness.
- Q: How long does an appointment take?
  A: A Bio Gel manicure is about 1 hour 40 minutes or more, extensions about 3 hours or more. Times vary with your nails and any art you add, so plan a relaxed visit.
- Q: How much does a Russian manicure cost?
  A: A Bio Gel manicure with Ekaterina is $250 and Bio Gel extensions are $370. Pricing for other techs and services shows on the booking page. Nail art is added on, from $20.
- Q: What is your cancellation policy?
  A: There is a 15-minute grace period for late arrivals. Please cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours ahead, or the full price of the booked service applies. The salon is adults only, with no children or pets.
- Q: Where are you and when are you open?
  A: 1311 S Mays St, Suite C, Round Rock, TX 78664, just south of downtown. Open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm. The booking page shows every open time.
